subject: Copywriting
title: Tiffany & Co.: The Color Is the Copy
description: A quick, practical guide to Tiffany & Co.: The Color Is the Copy.

buildup.text: Tiffany's copy is warm and intimate: 'Some things never change' and 'True love.' The tone is a love letter, not an ad.

discovery.text: The 1961 film 'Breakfast at Tiffany's' gave the brand literary glamour.

twist.text: After LVMH acquired Tiffany in 2021, the copy pivoted: 'Not Your Mother's Tiffany.' Heritage gave way to rebellion.

climax.text: Tiffany proves a color can be copy. When the visual identity is strong enough, words are accessories, not essentials.

punchline.text: Pantone 1837. A color so powerful it doesn't need words to sell.

quiz.question: What is the Pantone number of Tiffany blue?
